location_exception_reason: Smoking cabins are standardised prefabricated units; buyer decision is driven by ventilation spec, capacity, and compliance features, not geographic origin. Location in title adds no product intelligence.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Manufacturer,' 'Supplier,' 'Dealer') are redundant in smoking cabin titles—IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing the word leaves the product meaning unchanged.
